reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: neither p0001 nor p0009 grants Kubient any audit, inspection, records-examination or usage-verification right against the Customer, so there is nothing for the AUDIT rule (which protects the Customer) to constrain.

The only access language in p0001 is ordinary cooperation/access to enable Kubient to deliver the Services, not a right to audit Customer usage, books or systems; no remote or on-site system-access audit right exists.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected for a compliant finding; the unchanged paragraphs and empty comment are appropriate.
The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is an artifact of compliance-by-absence (no audit clause exists to bear frequency limits) and does not indicate a defect.

The rationale correctly flags the 'as measured by Kubient' measurement issue in p0009 as an audit right in the Customer's favour, i.e., out of scope for this rule's direction, rather than mislabeling it as a deviation here.
